definitions.explanation: A feeling of uncertainty or skepticism about something.
In grammar, relates to question forms.

examples.japanese: {疑問|ぎもん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
{疑問|ぎもん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
{疑問|ぎもん}⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If you have any questions, please ask.

examples.japanese: {疑問|ぎもん}⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作|つく}り→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧
「⟦いつ→いつ：00536_itsu⟧」「⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧」⟦など→など：03095_nado⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{疑問|ぎもん}⟦{詞|し}→詞：noentry⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: Words like 'when' and 'where' are called interrogative words.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{疑問|ぎもん}⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{文末|ぶんまつ}→文末：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧」⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Japanese interrogative sentences often add 'ka' at the end of the sentence.

notes:
{疑問|ぎもん} expresses doubt or questions.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {疑問|ぎもん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧ (to have doubts)
- {疑問|ぎもん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to have a question)
- {疑問|ぎもん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|いだ}く→抱く：02010_idaku⟧ (to harbor doubts)
- {疑問|ぎもん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧ (doubts remain)

GRAMMAR TERMS:
- {疑問|ぎもん}⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧ (interrogative sentence)
- {疑問|ぎもん}⟦{詞|し}→詞：noentry⟧ (interrogative word)
- {疑問|ぎもん}⟦{形|けい}→形：noentry⟧ (question form)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {疑問|ぎもん}: doubt, question (abstract)
- ⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧: question (concrete, asking)
- ⟦{疑|うたが}い→疑い：09757_utagai⟧: doubt, suspicion
